description.introduction: PZ Admin is an application for managing Project Zomboid servers. Manage players, edit server options, and run console commands from one interface.
description.offlineTools: The item browser, vehicle browser, and message editor can also be used without connecting to a server. PZ Admin includes catalogs and options for Builds 41 and 42.
description.requirements: Server management requires a running Project Zomboid server with RCON enabled.

features.catalogs: Give items to players and spawn vehicles using searchable catalogs.
features.connectionProfiles: Connect to your servers through RCON and save connection profiles.
features.messageEditor: Compose messages with a rich text editor that supports Project Zomboid formatting.
features.playerManagement: Manage players: assign roles, grant XP, teleport, and perform moderation actions.
features.serverActions: Control the weather, trigger server events, and save the world.
features.serverOptions: Edit server options and run console commands.

permissions.localNetwork: This allows you to connect to Project Zomboid servers on your local network.
